title: Spider-Man
desc: When bitten by a genetically modified spider, a shy high school student gains spider-like abilities that he must use to fight evil.

title: Spider-Man 2
desc: Peter Parker battles the brilliant Doctor Otto Octavius while struggling to balance his failing personal life.

title: Spider-Man 3
desc: Peter Parker deals with a symbiote that brings out his dark side, while facing Sandman and Venom.

title: The Amazing Spider-Man
desc: Peter Parker finds a clue about his parents' disappearance, putting him on a collision course with Dr. Curt Connors.

title: Spider-Man: Homecoming
desc: Following Civil War, Peter Parker balances high school life with being Spider-Man while facing the Vulture.

title: Spider-Man: Far From Home

title: Venom

title: Morbius

title: Iron Man

desc: Tony Stark faces Ivan Vanko, a vengeful physicist who wants to destroy everything he has built.

title: Iron Man 3
desc: Tony Stark faces the Mandarin, a mysterious villain who pushes him to his limits and forces him to think outside the suit.

title: Doctor Strange
